headline: Airbnb Raises Revenue Forecast on Global Demand and Corporate Travel
summary: Airbnb raised its revenue growth forecast, fueled by strong global demand and corporate travel, contrasting with more cautious outlooks from traditional hotel operators.
why: Guidance upgrades by major travel platforms provide insight into consumer travel trends and broader discretionary spending resilience.

impacts.name: Airbnb
impacts.why: Upgraded revenue forecasts are generally positive for the company's stock valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
